Thr. Principal Secy. Home Lko ... on 10 March, 2025

Author: Saurabh Lavania
Bench: Saurabh Lavania
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:14361
Court No. - 12
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 2178 of 2025
Applicant :- Ziauddin Ahmad Khan @ Ziauddin Khan And Another
Opposite Party :- State Of Up Thr. Principal Secy. Home Lko And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Abrar Ali

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: State Of Up Thr. Principal Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anadi Kumar Singh Hon'ble Saurabh Lavania,J.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Instant application has been preferred by the applicant(s) for the following main relief(s):-
"Wherefore, it is most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble court may kindly be pleased to quash the impugned summoning order dated 31.3.2023, issued by Additional chief judicial magistrate court no. 27, Lucknow, State Vs. Ziauddin Ahmad Khan and others, as well as impugned chargesheet no. 01/2022 dated 16.12.2022 alongwith entire criminal proceedings of the case, arising out of case crime no.
Ziauddin Ahmad Khan @ Ziauddin Khan And ... vs State Of Up Thr. Principal Secy. Home Lko ... on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105998919/
1 212/2022, under section 377,498A, 323,504,506 I.P.C and 3/4 D.P.Act against the applicant no. 1 and under section 498-A,504 I.P. C and 3/4 D.P. Act, against the applicant no. 2, Police station Saadatganj, Distt. Lucknow, pending before the concerned judicial Magistrate (A.T.S.) Lucknow, in the interest of justice as contained in Annexure no. 1 and 2 on the basis of compromise dated 28.2.2025 as contained in Annexure ??. 4."
It is stated that both the parties have amicably settled their dispute outside the Court and have entered into a compromise and a copy of compromise deed, duly signed by the parties, is annexed as Annexure No. 4 to the present application.

entities.text: Ziauddin Ahmad Khan @ Ziauddin Khan And ... vs State Of Up Thr. Principal Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As such, keeping in view the settlement arrived at between the parties and the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in this regard, the proceedings impugned are liable to be quashed.

Whether the parties have, in fact, compromised the matter or not, can best be ascertained by the trial court as such compromise has to be duly verified in presence of the parties concerned before the Court.

Considering the aforesaid, this application is disposed of finally in following terms:-
(i) The parties to the proceedings in issue shall appear and file the compromise before the concerned court within four week's from today.
(ii) If the parties appear before the concerned court in terms of above, the concerned Court shall proceed to verify the compromise between the parties to the proceedings and prepare a report to the same effect and the original compromise deed be made part of record.
(iii) The concerned court shall conclude the process of verification of compromise within two week's from the date of production of copy of this order.
(iv) The concerned court shall permit the parties to the proceedings to obtain the certified copy of the report as well as compromise deed.
(v) It shall be open to the applicant(s) to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings.
(vi) Office is directed to provide original compromise, if any, to the counsel for the applicant(s), after retaining its photocopy on record.
It is for the purposes for its verification by the concerned court.
(vii) For a period of eight weeks, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant(s) in the aforesaid case.

Order Date :- 10.3.2025 Arun/-
